faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most common questions

items.question: What is your service area?
items.answer: We work throughout Barcelona and the Maresme region. We come to your home at no additional cost within our coverage area.

items.question: How long does it take to get a quote?
items.answer: We commit to providing a quote within 1 hour of receiving your enquiry with photos of the issue or installation needed.

items.question: Is the quote free?
items.answer: Yes, our quotes are completely free and with no obligation.

items.question: What warranty do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a minimum of 6 months warranty on labour and 2 years on materials, as required by law.

items.question: What are your working hours?
items.answer: Our service hours are Monday to Saturday, from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

items.question: Can I send photos of the issue?
items.answer: Absolutely! In fact, we encourage you to send photos via WhatsApp. This helps us better assess the work and give you a more accurate quote.

items.question: Do you work on weekends?
items.answer: Yes, we work on Saturdays with regular hours (8:00 AM - 8:00 PM). We do not offer regular service on Sundays and public holidays.
